## Activity

During October 2020, Market Eye Clinic recorded 290 captures. Activity was completed as part of the clinic’s routine eye service, with the available records submitted for grading. The reported activity provides the basis for monitoring service volume and reviewing the timeliness and quality of the screening process.

## Image quality

There were 14 ungradable captures, representing an ungradable rate of 4.8 per cent. These images could not be assessed reliably and should be considered in the clinic’s ongoing review of capture practice. The rate provides a measure for routine monitoring of image quality at the site.

Staff raised no new equipment faults this month. This indicates that the image-quality findings were not associated with any newly reported equipment issue.

## Grading

A total of 43 results were graded referable. The median grading lag was 1 day. This indicates that grading was generally completed promptly during the reporting period. The referable results should continue through the appropriate follow-up pathway in line with established service arrangements. Overall, the activity, image-quality, and grading measures provide a summary of the clinic’s operational performance for October 2020.
